ListingHeroGallery: Has no phone frame to photograph, by construction: this is the DESKTOP arm of the listing gallery (`<ListingDetailPane galleryLayout="hero">`, the default only when the host says `layout="split"`), and a phone renders `galleryLayout="strip"` instead — a snap-scrolling row with its own counter, which is a different component's job. A phone variant here would photograph a hero and a filmstrip that no phone ever receives, and call it coverage. The phone surface for the same job IS photographed: listings.photo-strip, variants `default` / `single`, both at phone width.
